Naomi / Susan — I reviewed the redlines and sketched a path forward. Notes below and attached annotated workbook (SCCS-annotated.xlsx) with clause pointers.

Summary of legal position:
- SCCs: Redwood is comfortable using an SCC annex approach. We will reference the latest Commission SCCs by ID and include a short annex listing our core subprocessors and their roles. We will not host Commission text but will incorporate the references and a link to the authoritative source.
- Roles table: we propose tightening the table to two columns (Controller / Processor) and adding a "Processor-subprocessor" row that maps specific activities (hosting, backups, analytics). This avoids ambiguous delegations.
- Transfer fallback: we can accept a fall-back to SCCs if the DPA isn't finalized at signature, but need a defined remediation window (30 days) and a mutual cooperation clause for interim safeguards.
- Evidence: SOC2 Type II summary + KMS configuration summary + encryption-in-transit attestations are sufficient for procurement to unblock. We can prepare a sanitized evidence packet.

Action items (I will own legal outputs):
- Deliver proposed DPA text with annex (DPA_approved_text.docx) and an SCC annex draft by Mon 8/25 COB.
